answer: The forge issues a cryptographic kernel token to each new agent after it stakes a deposit in the vault and solves a proof‑of‑identity puzzle; the token is required to submit predictions to the peer‑prediction market. Each round the market scores reports with a Bayesian truth serum, rewarding only agents whose answers increase information gain, and confiscates the deposit of any token that fails to earn a minimum score. An attacker must lock up the full deposit per fake identity and forfeit it if the token is scored below threshold, making the cost equal to the deposit amount per Sybil.
